description: Get a company's share-repurchase (buyback) picture: tracked repurchase programs (announcement date, authorized total in money or shares, remaining availability, expiry, source filings), the latest program-authorization figures, and the repurchase history — cash spent, shares repurchased, and average price per fiscal year and recent quarters. Figures come from the company's own XBRL facts plus verified extractions of its filings' narrative text and its own press releases, including a Canadian normal course issuer bid's maximum number of shares; nothing is estimated, and figures a company stopped restating carry an explicit staleness label. For a B3 listing (BVMF:TICKER) it also lists every buyback program the board approved, newest first, with its approval and end dates, status, the most shares it may buy of each kind and class against that class's free float, and whether the shares bought may be cancelled or are kept in treasury, plus the company's treasury shares. For the dilution mirror-image — at-the-market (ATM) equity offering programs — use GetAtmPrograms.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XTSE:WDO, BVMF:VALE3) for a listing outside the US.
